blocks.text: ILOILO CITY—A person died, while eight others were rescued after a boat capsized off the coast of an island town in Antique province on Sunday, September 6. The Philippine Coast Guard (PCG) of Antique Province confirmed that MBCA San Agustin IV capsized off the waters of Sitio Liwagao, Semirara Island, Caluya town around 6:45 am of September 6. The PCG-Antique did not yet release the name of the lone fatality. The PCG initially received a call from the boat owner when the boat failed to arrive at Kaminawit Port of San Jose town, Occidental Mindoro province, during its scheduled docking time of 5 p.m. on Saturday, September 5. The PGC-Semirara Station initially tried to conduct a rescue operation on Saturday evening, but did not push through due to stormy weather. It was early on Sunday morning that PCG-Semirara Station with the help of the tugboat of Semirara Mining Corp. Meanwhile, the PCG-Semirara Station and PCG-Antique are still conducting an investigation as to what led to the incident.
